description: Source code for FIS table updating functions for MTD in OpenWRT, including functions for opening, validating, and remapping FIS tables, as well as related data structures.

methods.name: fis_close
methods.description: Closes the FIS table, unmapping memory and closing file descriptors.

methods.name: fis_open
methods.description: Opens and maps the FIS table from flash memory.

methods.name: fis_validate
methods.description: Validates the FIS table against old and new partition info.

methods.name: fis_remap
methods.description: Remaps the FIS table with new partition data.
